current_supported_challenge.scope: A new source-rule verifier, not repaired raw HHEM predictions or a general financial judge.

prior_format_boundaries.scope: A new source-rule verifier, not repaired raw HHEM predictions or a general financial judge.

limitations: Finite explicit source-admission rules are not general natural-language entailment.
Mixed illustrative/actual documents may be conservatively deferred.
Turnover/top-line aliases and spelled-out amounts are not silently equated to revenue.
Human-labelled independent real-source accuracy remains unavailable.

current_reader_regressions.overlap: Harder model subset overlaps all288; coverage/cell sources are reused elsewhere. Do not pool as independent observations.
current_reader_regressions.contract_warning: Old cohorts use a new source-proof diagnostic, not their original single-quote scorer. Field-labelled cohorts retain field-record-v1.

requirements.target: Every declared supported regression case correct; never loosen proof/tuple checks to reach target.

lineage.matching_policy: LF/CRLF equivalence only; hashes record raw local bytes
